column1: # Limitations the judge accepts for failed inventory rows. A failed row is a LIMIT (host-*) or UPSTREAM only when all of:
#   accepts   the failed value matches this pattern: the specific message of THIS limitation (never a pattern that would

#   cause     every condition holds on the measured facts of any session: FACT~REGEX or FACT!~REGEX joined by ' && '
#   proof     every row listed (space separated) is PASS: the tool works wherever the cause does not apply
